      "name": "tests",

      "band": "Unranked",

      "name": "validation",

      "evidence": "Labeled Validation; modifies src/validation.cpp to flush and hash the UTXO set during IBD block connection to verify AssumeUTXO commitments.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds crowdsourced verification of hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshot hashes during standard IBD, providing an auditing safeguard against erroneous hardcoded snapshot commitments. While useful for decentralizing trust in hardcoded snapshots (#32377), standard IBD already independently validates all blocks from genesis, making this an elective hardening feature that is reasonably deferrable."
